voice.profile: Project docs: corporate-advantage-email-sequence.md is the voice spine. Memory: dawn-kirk-brand-system.md
rules: Career-positive, agency-forward. No threat framing (layoffs, being passed over as danger)
Persuasion by recognition: make the reader feel seen, never analyzed. Survey data is invisible scaffolding
Executive thought leadership on LinkedIn: her employer and peers read it. Every post passes 'does this strengthen her professional standing'
Registration links in the first comment on LinkedIn, never the post body
Vocabulary: work-life integration (never balance), walk alongside you, indispensable, thirty years in these rooms, driver or passenger, inside work
Show all sides of Dawn: executive, coach, mom, wife. Growing the person behind the corporate brand
Business and corporate quotes from well known names are fine; Dawn-only on photos
No 'not X, it's Y' antithesis. No em dashes. Tone 4 skin tone on emojis

Quote cards: her calls are source material, not script. Write the line for the reader's benefit (a principle, a practice, a reframe). Never post anything that reads as self-protection, venting, insider complaint, or status management, even if she said it verbatim. Rod, Oct 12 2026: 'you dont have to quote her exact.. just pull from what she has said to create other things that make sense'

audience_lanes: Mid-career professional who does everything right and still gets overlooked
Executive-track leader building visibility on purpose
Working parent integrating career and home
cadence: One post per day, 06:45 ET (Dawn posts before 7:30am or after 5pm only). Oct 15 to Oct 29 for The Corporate Advantage
approval: Rod reviews one carousel + one quote first. Then weekly batches, Rod approves every Monday, until he grants no-approval weekly batches
